title: You don’t hear it preached like this anymore… but Jesus spoke about it more than heaven.
paragraphs: You don’t hear it preached like this anymore… but Jesus spoke about it more than heaven.
And that should make you pause.

Because if He—the embodiment of love—didn’t avoid the topic…
why do we?

A man stands at the edge of eternity.
No applause. No crowd. No second chances.
And here’s what most people don’t realize…

Hell is not a myth designed to scare people.
It’s a reality revealed by a holy God who refuses to lie.
🔥 WHAT THE BIBLE ACTUALLY SAYS ABOUT HELL

Hell is described as a place of conscious torment (Luke 16:23).
Not sleep. Not silence. Not non-existence.

A place of unquenchable fire (Mark 9:43)
A place of outer darkness (Matthew 8:12)
A place where there is weeping and gnashing of teeth
Because hell is not just physical suffering.
It is complete separation from God—the source of all light, joy, peace, and goodness.
Everything good is gone with Him.
But here’s where it gets even more serious…
Hell was never created for humans.
It was prepared for the devil and his angels (Matthew 25:41).
So why do people go there?
But because sin separates us from Him.

It’s choosing self over God.
Truth over lies.
Light over darkness.
And every single one of us is guilty.
Which means sin must be judged.
“For the wages of sin is death…” (Romans 6:23)
Because this is where everything changes.
But here’s what most people don’t realize…
God didn’t leave us headed toward hell.
In the person of Jesus Christ.
He took the punishment meant for you.
On the cross, Jesus absorbed the wrath of God against sin.
“God demonstrates His love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

Under judgment
or
Covered by grace
“By grace you have been saved through faith…” (Ephesians 2:8)
If this found you… it’s not by accident.
And there’s more you need to see…
Because understanding hell isn’t about fear.
What you do with Jesus now determines everything later.
If you stood before God today… what would cover your sin?
